E0339

A computed field given in a struct literal or assigned to directly (D-FIELDPOL1)

What

A computed field given in a struct literal or assigned to directly (D-FIELDPOL1)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0339

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0339: tests/ui/computed_field_set.stderr.

Error [E0339]: `attack` is a computed field on `Stats` — it can't be set
  --> tests/ui/computed_field_set.jet:7:30
    |
  7 |     s := Stats{strength: 10, attack: 5}
    |                              ^^^^^^
 Why: `attack` is declared `attack -> …` — its value always comes from that formula, never from a struct literal
 Fix: remove `attack` from this `.{ … }`
